title: Top N Employees by Salary per Department
description: Find the top 3 highest-paid employees in each department using ROW_NUMBER.

data.text: Write a query to find the top 3 highest-paid employees in each department.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
WITH RankedEmployees AS (
    SELECT
        EmployeeID,
        FirstName,
        LastName,
        Department,
        Salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Department ORDER BY Salary DESC) AS RowNum
    FROM Employees
)
SELECT EmployeeID, FirstName, LastName, Department, Salary
FROM RankedEmployees
WHERE RowNum <= 3
ORDER BY Department, Salary DESC;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: ROW_NUMBER() assigns a unique sequential number within each partition (Department), ordered by Salary DESC. The CTE (WITH clause) lets us filter on this rank in the outer query. PARTITION BY is like GROUP BY for window functions.
